parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue by excluding return types for classes, but it may introduce regressions or have maintainability concerns.

issues.description: The change may break existing behavior for other types of objects that should include return types.
The code change is minimal but could be improved with comments to explain the conditional exclusion of return types for classes.
